content.title: Los Angeles Angels TV Schedule
content.text: See how to watch or stream every game of the 2026 Los Angeles Angels season with the following TV schedule and streaming guide. For the full Major League Baseball regular season schedule, see the preceding link. If you purchase a subscription through a link on this page, this site may receive a commission. Access to Angels telecasts only. MLB.TV (out-of-market only): All out-of-market locally televised games. New users purchase MLB.TV subscriptions through ESPN, which includes a one-month free trial of ESPN Unlimited that be canceled at any time. Existing subscribers to MLB.TV are auto-renewed as usual. Consumers can watch MLB.TV through the league’s platform or ESPN with valid authentication. More information about local Angels broadcasts can be found here. National games: Peacock: All NBC Sports-produced games on the NBC broadcast network and Peacock. ESPN Unlimited: All ESPN-produced games on the ESPN cable networks and ABC, plus the ability to purchase MLB.TV as an add-on subscription. Disney+: Occasional simulcasts of ESPN-produced games. Apple TV: All “Friday Night Baseball” games throughout the season. HBO Max: All TNT Sports-produced games on the TBS cable network. Fox One: All Fox Sports-produced games on the Fox broadcast network and FS1. Netflix: Access to watch Opening Night, the Home Run Derby and the MLB at Field of Dreams Game. Sling: All games on ESPN/ABC (ABC games will be on ESPN3), Fox/FS1, NBC and TBS. Fubo: All games on ESPN/ABC and Fox/FS1. DIRECTV (stream): All games on ESPN/ABC, NBC, Fox/FS1 and TBS. Linear cable (ex. Dish Network, Xfinity, DIRECTV): All games on ESPN/ABC, NBC, Fox/FS1 and TBS. Hulu + Live TV: All games on ESPN/ABC, NBC, Fox/FS1 and TBS. In-Person See the Angels in person at Angel Stadium, or catch Major League Baseball games from any of the 30 ballparks this season, by purchasing tickets through Vivid Seats, SeatGeek or Gametime.
